title: Polymarket bot — trading (paper)
description: WP-240 trading view: decisions, risk vetoes (including the WP-220 risk-seam residual), execution, fills and accounting record counts. PAPER deployment: execution is simulated, and this dashboard exposes no control of any kind.

panels.title: Decisions persisted
panels.description: §6 invariant 3: every strategy callback produces exactly one persisted DecisionResult. This series and 'Evaluations' should move together; a divergence is a persistence problem, not a strategy one.

panels.title: Evaluations and containments
panels.description: A containment is ADR-005 §3: the runtime paused an instance. A refused evaluation never ran.

panels.title: Risk approvals and refusals
panels.description: §9.8 pre-trade gate. Every intent that reaches submission passed through here; a refusal is a trade that did not happen.

panels.title: Risk vetoes by reason code
panels.description: §14.3 risk: vetoes by reason. The code is the risk engine's own structured reason, not a message.

panels.title: Refused protective exits by reason code
panels.description: The WP-220 risk-seam residual, counted. These are refusals of intents the emitting strategy tagged PROTECTIVE. Read this panel together with the caveat text beside it: a non-zero series is the accepted fail-closed posture (a refused exit, never a wrong order), not a bug in the strategy.

panels.title: The WP-220 risk-seam caveat
panels.description: 1 while at least one protective exit has been refused in this run, so the residual is ACTIVE rather than merely documented. Every exit the static-bracket strategy emits is a §7.7 POSITION intent, and packages/risk derives disposition from the intent TYPE alone, so a protective reduction is classified ENTRY — and is therefore refused inside the entry cutoff, on CLOSE_ONLY markets, with the entry-shaped staleness code, and under the default requirePositiveNetEdgeForEntries for want of an expectedNetEdge. This is the ACCEPTED posture until the risk-side follow-up lands. The trader does not weaken risk policy, re-tag intents or bypass the engine to compensate; it counts the refusals, and this dashboard shows them.

panels.title: Execution plans and submissions
panels.description: §9.10 reserves capital BEFORE submission, so an allocation refusal is a plan that never left the process, while a submission refusal reached the (simulated) venue and returned its reservation.

panels.title: Fills
panels.description: Fills observed and redeliveries the dedup seam refused. §6 invariant 10 makes partial fills first class; a redelivery refused here is the at-most-once gate working, not a lost fill.

panels.title: Cancels
panels.description: §6 invariant 13: safety cancellation outranks new order placement. A cancel whose silence bound elapsed is NOT a rejection (§6 invariant 6) and is counted separately.

panels.title: Ledger and PnL record counts
panels.description: COUNTS, not amounts. Unattributed activity and unexplained movements each halt the affected market (§6 invariant 7, §9.15); a ledger refusal means an accounting record is incomplete.

panels.title: Realized PnL
panels.description: This panel is intentionally not bound to a metric. See its content.

options.content:
PENDING PRODUCER: an exact-decimal PnL value on the trader's health surface; today it carries only accounting.pnlRecords (a COUNT), and packages/pnl's snapshot values never reach an exporter — OWNER: a future apps/trader grant (the health surface is apps/trader-owned; WP-240 is read-only there)

WP-240 will not invent a `trader_pnl` gauge: a PnL amount is an exact decimal (§6 invariant 1) and a float64 sample value is the representation that invariant forbids. When a producer exists it will arrive as an `_info` label carrying the exact decimal string, the way reserved collateral already does — see 'Reserved collateral (exact decimals)' on this dashboard for the shape.

panels.title: Reserved collateral (exact decimals)
panels.description: The only economic amounts on this dashboard, and they are LABELS. The value column is always 1; read the exact_decimal label. Nothing here is charted, summed, or rate()'d — arithmetic on these would reintroduce binary floating point into economics (§6 invariant 1). The control API's JSON read surface returns the same strings.

panels.title: Incident recommendations (§9.9)
panels.description: §9.9 actions the risk engine RECOMMENDED, by action. A recommendation is not an action: the Incident Controller and the operator act, and the trader's own act is only to stop deciding for a halted scope.
